records.title: Natural Earth 1:110m land outlines
assumptions: Land polygon boundaries displayed as low-resolution coastline context.
Snapshot timestamp is upstream commit date, not observation date.
records.uncertainty: Cartographic generalization at 1:110 million; not survey-grade coastline.
limitations: Small islands and local detail are omitted.
Not terrain, buildings, administrative borders, or a hazard model.
Hidden below 200 km camera altitude rather than implying local accuracy.
records.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso and contributors.
records.license: Public domain; upstream license bundled with snapshot.
